fusions.name: Bitter Mouthful
fusions.desc: Bites with your weapon for 8 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Passed Around
fusions.desc: Snaps at every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 10 damage, with a 50% chance each to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Licked Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and restores 8 health. It grows 10% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Spent Venom
fusions.desc: Whenever one of your afflictions on an enemy wears off, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds, once every 8 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. You have 10% poison resistance.
